Lemma
[Riemannian connections satisfy Koszul's formula]

↗ def:pet-ch2-riemannian-connection ↗ rem:pet-ch2-koszul-formula

Every Riemannian connection $ abla $ on $(M,g)$ satisfies $2g( abla _YX,Z)=D_Xg(Y,Z)+D_Yg(X,Z)-D_Zg(X,Y) -g([X,Y],Z)-g([Y,Z],X)+g([Z,X],Y)$.
Proof

\sketch Expand the three metric derivatives by compatibility and replace every bracket by the torsion-free identity. Symmetry of $g$ cancels all terms except $2g( abla _YX,Z)$.

□
